answer: Bind each identity to one physical device through a manufacturer-signed hardware attestation: a secure enclave proves a real chip stands behind the account, and the same chip cannot vouch for a second identity. A farm then faces an ocean of hardware purchases instead of a free script — every clone needs a terrace of bought devices stacked on a shelf. The prism here is cost: the defence works only if attestation keys stay unforgeable and cheap phones stay attestable, so the check must accept many vendors rather than one gatekeeper.
